differences: Step order differs: Text A destroys the target creature first and then, if you control an artifact, deals 3 damage to its controller; Text B checks for an artifact and deals the damage before destroying the creature. If the target is an artifact you control, destroying it first removes the condition, so the damage would not happen in Text A but would in Text B.
Text B's 'Target creature.' is a bare target line with the destruction moved to the end; the overall step sequence is not the same as Text A.
